_readme: DRAFT test set for Research_Paper.pdf, written by Claude. NOT final until YOU have verified it.
Text-answer labels were checked by script against the PDF's text layer. Figure-only labels were checked by viewing the figures and confirming the words are absent from the text layer.
For EVERY question: read the pages in gold_pages, decide whether any other page also answers it on its own, then set verified to true.
Rewrite about one third of the questions in your own words before running (these may echo the paper's phrasing).
Rule used for gold_pages: a page counts if it contains enough to answer the question on its own. For multi-page questions, every page that supplies a needed part counts.
Freeze this file (git commit) BEFORE running run_baseline. Do not edit labels after you see results.
